evaluate_2000_rows_x_50_rules.definition: cold = evaluate+persist (facts incl. 2,000 rows are stored with EACH of the 50 evaluations); warm = idempotent repeat of identical inputs

event_burst.definition: latency = submit evaluate -> case committed and visible from a second session

targets.note: no performance target was specified in the compliance spec section used here; numbers are reported as measured

caveats: Shared development host: other agents run builds/tests concurrently; see load_* fields. Numbers are not a clean-room measurement.
Facts (including the 2,000-row positions array) are persisted with every evaluation by design (replayability); storage grows linearly with rules x rows.
Burst positions are caller-supplied (CALLER_SUPPLIED provenance); margin/collateral services are not part of this latency.
Single Python process, SQLAlchemy sessions on a local Docker PostgreSQL; no network hop.
